extension.name: Membership Analytics
extension.description: Membership analytics: event-sourced membership change log, period snapshots, and contact dimension history for status/movement/trend reporting.

compatibility.comments: Semantic versioning. For example, compatibility with "6.1" implies compatibility with "6.2".

php_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "8.1" and "8.2".

smarty_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "4" and "5".

extension.comments: Phase 1 scaffold: schema (event/snapshot/dimension), option groups, settings, activity types, and Calculate/Backfill action skeletons. Backfill/snapshot internals and reports are in progress.
